name: Ambush at Checkpoint Delta
description: Alpha squad was conducting a security patrol when they were ambushed by small arms fire at Checkpoint Delta. Four soldiers sustained injuries from direct fire and fragmentation.
environment: Urban checkpoint, daytime, moderate cover available

casualties.narrative: SGT Morrison took a round to the right chest. Sucking chest wound visible, decreasing SpO2, tachycardic.
CPL Santos hit by concrete fragments in lower left leg. Superficial wounds, ambulatory. NOTE: Penicillin allergy — adjust antibiotics.
PFC Kim was struck by vehicle debris. Obvious right femur deformity, severe pain, moderate swelling. NOTE: Type 2 Diabetic on Metformin.
SPC Williams has minor lacerations to forearms from glass fragments. Bleeding controlled with pressure.

key_allergy_flags: CPL Santos — Penicillin allergy (severe). Do NOT use Penicillin for wound prophylaxis. Use Moxifloxacin 400mg PO.

name: IED Strike on Convoy
description: A vehicle-borne IED detonated alongside a convoy. Five soldiers from multiple vehicles sustained blast, burn, and ballistic injuries. Mass casualty event.
environment: Rural road, daytime, vehicles disabled, secondary attack possible

casualties.narrative: SSG Tanaka — traumatic amputation of right arm above the elbow from blast. Active arterial hemorrhage, tourniquet applied. NOTE: History of prior pneumothorax — monitor for recurrence.
CPT Volkov — 35% BSA burns from vehicle fire, face and torso. Conscious but in severe pain. CRITICAL: Morphine allergy — must use Ketamine for pain management.
SGT Nair — blast-induced TBI, confused, GCS 11, unequal pupils. NOTE: G6PD deficiency — avoid oxidative drugs.
SPC O'Brien — multiple shrapnel wounds to back and legs. None penetrating deeply. Ambulatory with assistance. NOTE: Latex allergy — use nitrile gloves.
LT Hawkins — secondary small arms fire during the ambush, GSW to abdomen. Hemodynamically unstable, rigid abdomen.

expected_triage_order: SSG Tanaka (T1 — Traumatic amputation, score ~94+8=100, pneumothorax history bonus)
SGT Nair (T2 — Blast TBI, score ~73, G6PD modifier)
key_allergy_flags: CPT Volkov — Morphine allergy (severe). For pain management: Ketamine 50mg IM/IV ONLY.
SPC O'Brien — Latex allergy. Use NITRILE gloves for all treatment.
SGT Nair — G6PD deficiency. AVOID primaquine, dapsone, methylene blue.

name: Building Assault CQB
description: Close quarters battle during a building clearing operation. Three soldiers wounded by hostile fire and blast effects inside a confined structure.
environment: Indoor CQB, low light, confined spaces, dust and debris

casualties.narrative: PFC Ortega — hit by round that deflected off plate carrier, developing tension pneumothorax. Tracheal deviation, absent breath sounds on left. Needs immediate needle decompression.
CW2 Blake — GSW to left thigh, through-and-through, bleeding controlled with wound packing. NOTE: Codeine allergy + on Sertraline for PTSD — monitor for drug interactions.
SPC Williams — concussive blast from breaching charge. Dazed, mild headache, GCS 15. No LOC witnessed.

key_allergy_flags: CW2 Blake — Codeine allergy (moderate). For pain: use Ketamine. Also on Sertraline — avoid Tramadol (serotonin syndrome risk).
PFC Ortega — Tetracycline allergy (mild). Use Moxifloxacin for antibiotic prophylaxis.
